data.name: Galaxor
data.detailed_description:
About Galaxor

Galaxor is an online space strategy game where you build your own galactic empire, colonize planets, produce resources, research technologies and command powerful fleets.

Start with a single planet and grow step by step into an interstellar power. Build mines, power plants, research facilities, defensive structures and fleet bases. Research new technologies, expand your colonies and decide whether you want to shape your path through the galaxy as a trader, explorer, fleet commander or conqueror.

Long-Term Space Strategy

Galaxor focuses on long-term development, tactical planning and strategic decisions. Your economy, research, fleet movements and defenses need to work together.

Every decision affects your progress:

  • Which buildings do you upgrade first?

  • Which research gives you the greatest advantage?

  • When is it worth founding a new colony?

  • Do you attack other players or focus on development and trade?

  • Do you invest in defense or rely on mobile fleets?

Fleets, Battles and Expansion

Build different types of ships and use them for transport, espionage, colonization, recovery, attack and defense. Plan your flights, protect your resources and react to the movements of other players.

Colonize new planets, expand your empire and improve your position in the universe. Long-term success requires more than a strong fleet. You also need a stable economy and good planning.

Alliances and Player Interaction

Join forces with other players, create or join a clan and coordinate shared goals. Diplomacy, cooperation and competition all play an important role in Galaxor.

Together, you can act with greater strength, support each other and secure strategic advantages across the universe.

Events and Special Content

Regular events provide additional goals and variety. Players can earn special rewards, take part in time-limited activities and discover new challenges.

Content includes, among other things:

  • Construction and research bonuses

  • Fleet and PvP events

  • Alien activities

  • Salvage and exploration content

  • Special rewards and collectibles

The Void Universe

In addition to the normal universe, Galaxor offers special endgame content in the Void Universe. There you will encounter more dangerous regions, alien outposts, special resources and stronger enemies.

The Void is designed around exploration, risk and long-term progression. Those who venture deeper can earn valuable rewards, but must also be prepared for greater danger.

Key Features

  • Online space strategy game with long-term progression

  • Build and expand your own planets and colonies

  • Resource production, research and fleet construction

  • Different ship types for different purposes

  • Espionage, transport, colonization, attack and defense

  • Clans, diplomacy and player interaction

  • Events and special rewards

  • Void Universe with endgame content

  • Strategic decisions instead of fast round-based matches

  • Progression over days, weeks and months

Note

Galaxor is a persistent online game. A stable internet connection and a Galaxor game account are required.

data.short_description: Galaxor is an online sci-fi strategy game where you build planets, research technologies, command fleets and expand your empire across the galaxy. Manage resources, join clans, take part in events and face alien threats in long-term space warfare.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Dual-Core-Prozessor mit 2,0 GHz
  • Memory: 2048 M MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrierte oder dedizierte Grafikkarte mit WebGL-/DirectX-11-Unterstützung
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Nicht erforderlich
  • VR Support: Nicht unterstützt
  • Additional Notes: Galaxor ist ein Online-Weltraumstrategiespiel. Eine dauerhafte Internetverbindung und ein Galaxor-Spielkonto sind erforderlich.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 oder Windows 11 64-Bit
  • Processor: Quad-Core-Prozessor mit 2,5 GHz oder besser
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedizierte oder moderne integrierte Grafikkarte mit WebGL-/DirectX-11-Unterstützung
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Nicht erforderlich
  • VR Support: Nicht unterstützt
  • Additional Notes: Für ein flüssiges Spielerlebnis werden eine stabile Internetverbindung und ein aktueller Grafiktreiber empfohlen.
